name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role or class colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

added: The meter now shows each player's spec, like Icicle or Concerto, as soon as they are near you, even in town before any fight.
Your uploads now include each player's confirmed spec, so the logs site can show the right spec even for players who never used a signature skill.
changed: Smoother tracking when lots of players are around you, such as busy towns and raids.
fixed: A player who switches class no longer briefly shows a spec from their previous class on the meter.
